rows.en: (Crap! I'll be late if I don't hurry!)
Yo, \p.

Oh, it's Klan-senpai!
What are you doing in a place like this?

Oops, no time for that.
I'm in a hurry, so I'll get going!
See you later...

Wait, Klan-senpai, you graduated!
Why are you wearing a Mihoshi uniform!?

...When you treated me like normal at first,
I wondered what was going on.

(It doesn't look out of place at all,
Klan-senpai...)

I knew it... A college student wearing
a high school uniform is weird, right?
Huh! No, it's not really...

(If anything, it's the 'college student' part
that seems out of place...)

Well, today's just a bit of fun.
I'll wander around the school some more,
but weren't you in a hurry?

Oh!
Sorry, I've gotta go,
Klan-senpai!
Mm. Study hard, young man.

(Coming here in a Mihoshi uniform and all...
Does Klan-senpai really have that much
time on her hands?)
(Crap! I'll be late if I don't hurry!)

Oops, no time for that.
I'm in a hurry, so I'll get going!
See you later...
Mm. Study hard.

(Coming here in a Mihoshi uniform and all...
Does Klan-senpai really have that much
time on her hands?)

Wait, Klan-senpai...
You've put on the uniform and snuck into
Mihoshi again...
Once you try it, it's actually pretty fun.

(Please don't make weird stuff your hobby,
Klan-senpai...)

Well, I think I'll wander around
the school some more. See you.

(Well, with her looks, no one's ever going to
mistake Klan-senpai for a college student...)

(If anything, she's more likely to get
mistaken for a middle-school kid...)

(If anything, she's more likely to get
mistaken for a middle-school kid...)

(I came to Nyan-Nyan for lunch
with Klan-senpai, but...)
Sigh...

(She looked at the two maguro buns side by side
and suddenly let out a sigh.
I wonder what's wrong?)

If only they were at least this big
when I'm micronized...
rows.notes: Two maguro buns side by side: a bust joke. Kept as implicit as the Japanese ('this size').

rows.en:
What's gotten into you, Klan-senpai?
You've got the eyes of a girl
with some impossibly big dream...

No, it's nothing...
It's nothing at all......

(Hmm... I don't really get it, but
hang in there, Klan-senpai!)

(She looked at the two maguro buns side by side
and suddenly let out a sigh.
I wonder what's wrong?)

(Griffith Park feels a little sad
in the evening...)
Hm? If it isn't \p...

Klan-senpai,
what are you doing here?

I went to visit the grave of someone I knew,
and just stopped by here afterward...

Mm, this won't do...
I've gotten a bit gloomy.

Right! I know, \p!
We're going to Nyan-Nyan!
That's sudden, Klan-senpai...

It's not sudden! I've been dying to eat
maguro buns this whole time.
Now, let's go!
All right, Klan-senpai.

(I knew it. Klan-senpai's forcing herself
to put on a brave face...)

(Okay! Let's eat something tasty at Nyan-Nyan
and cheer Klan-senpai up!)

(Griffith Park feels a little sad
in the evening...)

(I knew it. Klan-senpai's forcing herself
to put on a brave face...)

(Okay! Let's eat something tasty at Nyan-Nyan
and cheer Klan-senpai up!)

(Central Park is so refreshing
on a sunny day like this.)
I just came for a little walk, but...

I was feeling nostalgic, remembering how
I used to play here with Michel and Jessica...
rows.notes: Jessica (Michel's older sister, Jessica Blanc per the Macross Wiki) is not in the glossary.

rows.en: Umm, Klan-senpai...?

Right! I know, \p!
We're going to Silver Moon!

It's not sudden! I've been dying for some tea
this whole time.
Now, let's go!

(Central Park is so refreshing
on a sunny day like this.)

(Taking a different way home like this
isn't bad once in a while...)

(Huh? Wait, it's Luis-san.
What on earth is he doing here?)
Luis-saaan!

Hm? Well, if it isn't Fresh Boy.
What on earth are you doing here?

I just happened to pass by on my way home.
What are you up to, Luis-san?

Very well... I'll answer that question.
I was practicing my dance!
D-Dance...?

You've got a 'what dance?' look on your face.
The Nyan-Nyan Dance!
Nyan! Nyan! Daaance!!
rows.notes: Japanese spells the name out syllable by syllable; rendered as a chant.

rows.en:
The one that ends with 'Yummy-nyan!'
It's on the commercials all the time lately, right?

Oh, I've seen it. They've been airing it
a lot late...
rows.notes: Cut off mid-word in the Japanese (Luis interrupts); kept unfinished.

rows.en:
I know! Check my moves for me, will ya!
I can't get the angle of my left elbow
right at the end.
Huh? H-Hold on...

Ahh, I'm getting nervous...
...All right! Here goes, Fresh Boy!

Gorgeous! Delicious! Deculture!
Yummy-nyan!!
rows.notes: Nyan-Nyan commercial jingle (oishii nyan); also spoken by the player.

rows.en:
...Phew, that's how it goes.
Was the angle of my left elbow okay?

...Umm,
why are you practicing the Nyan-Nyan Dance?

Gaaah! What were you even looking at!?
What kind of question is that!? Why weren't you
watching my left elbow!? Give me back my nerves!
S-Sorry...

Whoa...
Didn't expect you to get all sentimental.
Sorry for raising my voice.
Oh, yes, I'm fine...

See, Nyan-Nyan keeps me fed...
So I'm practicing the Nyan-Nyan Dance in case
they ever ask me to be in a commercial.
(I'm sure they'll never ask, though...)

And it's frustrating, man!
No matter how many times I do it, I'm nowhere
near as sharp a dancer as that one!
rows.notes: aitsu = the Nyan-Nyan mascot; gender unknown, so 'that one'.

rows.en:
...Who do you mean by 'that one'?
Don't tell me......

Yeah, the one who's always dancing
in the commercials...

(You don't have to get so competitive
with Nyan-Nyan's mascot character...)

uncertain: c08279: Klan sighs over two maguro buns side by side, 'if only they were at least this big when I'm micronized': a bust joke, kept implicit as in the Japanese.
c08318/c08313: Nyan-Nyan jingle 'oishii nyan' rendered 'Yummy-nyan!'; 'Deculture!' per glossary. Other slices with the jingle should match.
c08327-c08329: aitsu = the Nyan-Nyan mascot character, gender unknown; rendered 'that one'.
c08287: Klan visits 'the grave of someone she knew' (chijin); kept vague as in the Japanese.
